description: On a writable copy of the idx fixture Field TI.A (in ixU and ixMulti) is renamed to A2 and Field TI.ID (the primary key) to ID2, each through Field.Name with Name and DBEngine.Errors read. TI's Indexes (after Refresh) are then listed with Name, Primary, Unique, Clustered, IgnoreNulls, Required, Foreign, DistinctCount and Fields (Name, Attributes). After Close and reopen the Indexes are listed again.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
